children: Xactus will make FICO's Preferred Program available to all mortgage industry clients, including clients served through XedaLink and SharperLending, starting January 1, 2027. Bundled Classic FICO and FICO Score 10T pricing is $10 per bureau, per borrower; FICO's wholesale price is unchanged for 2027.
Extends distribution of FICO scores through Xactus and its platforms to mortgage industry clients.
Bundled scores cost $10 per bureau, per borrower
Sets the stated wholesale price for the Classic FICO and FICO Score 10T bundle; no prior price comparison is provided.
Confirms no wholesale price increase for 2027, limiting a potential pricing catalyst.

This is a distribution expansion for FICO's mortgage scoring products, rather than a new financial result or guidance update. Wider lender adoption of the program and FICO Score 10T would be needed to establish a measurable revenue impact.
